name: Cross-cutting — Shared chrome & patterns recurring across SCW screens

findings.fig: The masthead right zone carries the Digital India + SAMAVESH cobranding logos (DBIM).
findings.live: The masthead right zone is empty — both cobranding logos are absent across the public site.
findings.fix: Add the Digital India + SAMAVESH cobranding logos to the masthead right zone.

findings.fig: The masthead lockup includes the bold 'Department of Social Justice & Empowerment' line beneath the Ministry line.
findings.live: The masthead stops at 'Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment' — the Department line is absent.
findings.fix: Add the bold 'Department…' line beneath the Ministry line in the masthead lockup.

findings.el: Font family not rendering as Noto Sans
findings.fig: All text is set in Noto Sans (the DBIM standard typeface).
findings.live: Many build text elements render in a fallback face — Noto Sans is requested in CSS but isn't actually loading, so headings/body fall back to a system font.
findings.fix: Ensure the Noto Sans webfont actually loads on the build (font files + @font-face) so text doesn't fall back to a system face. Recurs site-wide.

findings.fig: The top utility bar carries an accessibility control (text-size + contrast) beside the language selector.
findings.live: The top bar shows only Skip-to-Main, a translate glyph and Login.
findings.fix: Add the accessibility (text-size / contrast) control to the top utility bar.

findings.fig: The expand/collapse trigger sits in the header, above the sidebar column.
findings.live: The collapse arrow (←) sits inside the sidebar column, above the nav items.
findings.fix: Move the expand/collapse trigger into the header, above the sidebar.

findings.fig: On gated forms the primary action stays disabled until the confirm checkbox / required fields are valid.
findings.live: The primary action renders enabled by default — recurs across SAGE / Volunteer / ALD.
findings.fix: Default the primary action to disabled until the required input is valid.
Set the “Senior Citizens Welfare” style to font-size 32px — the build currently uses font-size 24px.
Set the “Need Immediate Help?” style to font-size 16px, colour #d64539 — the build currently uses font-size 18px, colour #e65100.

findings.fig: Service-card icons are outline, single-tone marks.
findings.live: Cards use filled, multi-coloured glyph icons (green leaf, blue document).
findings.fix: Restyle the service-card icons to the design's outline, single-tone set.

findings.fig: The logo sits in a rounded-square container with generous breathing space around it.
findings.live: The logo container is a tight circle, cropping the breathing space.
findings.fix: Use a rounded-square logo container with the design's internal padding — not a circle.

findings.el: Role selector — dropdown vs segmented buttons
findings.fix: Use the design's single role dropdown rather than two segmented buttons.

findings.fig: Inputs use the design's field height, border colour, radius and focus state.
findings.live: The build's input fields and the primary button differ in height, border and radius from the design.
findings.fix: Match the input field height, border colour, radius and focus/disabled states to the design.
